name: Polly-O Part-Skim Ricotta Cheese (High Lactose WARNING)
whyItWorks: Ricotta is traditionally produced by reheating the sweet whey left over from cheese production. Because it is whey-derived rather than curd-based, it retains up to 4–6g of concentrated lactose per 1/2 cup, provoking rapid fermentation, loud rumbling, and watery diarrhea in lactose-sensitive IBD guts.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid standard ricotta during active flares. If baking lasagna, use 100% lactose-free ricotta or aged parmesan.
